name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['*']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions: read-all

jobs:
  source:
    name: Build source packages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install build tools
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y cmake build-essential

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build --config Release

      - name: Generate source packages
        run: |
          cd build
          cpack -G TBZ2
          cpack -G ZIP

      - name: Upload tarball
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: source-tarball
          path: build/*.tar.bz2

      - name: Upload zip
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: source-zip
          path: build/*.zip

  windows-installer:
    name: Build Windows installer
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Windows build composite action
        uses: ./.github/actions/windows-installer
        with:
          build_type: Release
          run_tests: false

      - name: Upload installer
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-installer
          path: build/installer/*.exe

  release:
    name: Publish release
    needs: [source, windows-installer]
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download source tarball
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: source-tarball
          path: artifacts/source-tarball

      - name: Download source zip
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: source-zip
          path: artifacts/source-zip

      - name: Download Windows installer
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-installer
          path: artifacts/windows-installer

      - name: Create GitHub release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref_name }}
          body: |
            Automated release generated by GitHub Actions.
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload source tarball asset
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: artifacts/source-tarball/*.tar.bz2
          asset_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}.tar.bz2
          asset_content_type: application/x-bzip2

      - name: Upload source zip asset
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: artifacts/source-zip/*.zip
          asset_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}.zip
          asset_content_type: application/zip

      - name: Upload Windows installer asset
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: artifacts/windows-installer/*.exe
          asset_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}-windows.exe
          asset_content_type: application/vnd.microsoft.portable-executable
